latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of YouTube Video Editor — Edit and Export YouTube Videos

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) for quick AI editing and 1080p MP4 export.
- Automatic session and token handling, including free anonymous access with 100 credits.
- Supports simple chat commands: trim, transitions, exports, credit checking, and timeline status.
- Clean connection and progress feedback; cloud GPU processing with rapid turnaround (typically 1–2 minutes).
- Handles multiple file types and gives clear error messages for unsupported files, token issues, or rate limits.
- Built to streamline edits for YouTubers without any installation or video editing expertise required.
